title: Uppercase a string
description: Write a function `to_upper(text)` that returns `text` with every character changed to uppercase.
hints: Every string has an .upper() method that returns a new string with every letter capitalized - it doesn't change the original string.
Call .upper() on text and return the result directly.
explanation: str.upper() is a built-in string method - no manual character-by-character loop is needed.
